column1: # glosses<TAB>sentence. ASL-style glosses written for this project; NOT reviewed by a fluent signer yet.
# Rules: every sentence must pass generation/constraints.py; no gloss sequence from benchmarks/glosses.jsonl.
# Tense: no time sign -> present tense. Past/future only from a time sign (YESTERDAY, TOMORROW, FINISH, WILL, ...).

column2: I do not want to go.
What do you want to eat?
I am sorry I am late.
My father works on a farm.
My grandmother lives in a village.
Yesterday I went to the store.
Yesterday I went to the park.
Last week I visited my grandmother.
Tomorrow I will go to the doctor.
Tomorrow I will visit a friend.
Please help me find the bathroom.

column1: # Round 2: WH-questions. ASL often puts the WH-sign last; English puts it first.

column2: What do you want to do tomorrow?
How do you go to school?
How much does the coffee cost?
